T: Goonies never say die. Goonies never say no to seconds.
D: A gang of kids follow an old treasure map to find a pirate's lost ship.
P: Serve the snacks when Chunk does the truffle shuffle.
S: Dark chocolate melted into hot cream with a knob of butter, chilled 3 hours, scooped and rolled into balls, then coated in cocoa, crushed nuts or sprinkles.
Chunk wins Sloth over with a chocolate bar

Chewy peanut nougat and salted caramel loaded with roasted peanuts, dipped in milk chocolate and cut into fat bars, the way Sloth would want them. Melt 200g marshmallows with 40g butter and 2 tbsp smooth peanut butter, then stir through 150g roasted peanuts and press into a lined 20cm tin. Melt 200g soft caramels with 2 tbsp cream and a pinch of salt and pour over. Chill 1 hour. Cut into 12 bars, dip in 300g melted milk chocolate and set on baking paper in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Sharp cheddar, butter, flour and smoked paprika rolled into a log, chilled, sliced into coins, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp.
M: the Fratellis' hideout in the old restaurant
Pizza dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, garlic and oregano, Italian sausage, mushrooms and mozzarella, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
the Walsh house on the Goon Docks in Astoria

Flathead in a crunchy soda water batter, piled into warm tortillas with chipotle slaw, pickled onion, avocado and lime, a pirate map's worth of crunch. Pickle 1 sliced red onion in the juice of 2 limes with salt for 20 minutes. Toss a quarter red cabbage, shredded, with 100g mayonnaise and 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold soda water and salt. Cut 600g flathead into strips, dip and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Warm 12 flour tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion, sliced avocado and lime.
W: One-Eyed Willy's ship, full of gold
Chocolate loaf cake baked at 170C for 50 minutes, hollowed out and filled with gold-wrapped chocolate coins, lid on, covered in chocolate ganache.
K: the kids' summer on the docks
Root beer poured slowly over vanilla ice cream in tall glasses until it foams to the top.

s.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate with 20g butter. Stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Scoop and roll into balls and coat in cocoa, crushed peanuts or sprinkles.

Rub 80g butter into 150g flour, add 150g grated cheddar, a pinch of smoked paprika and cayenne, and bring together. Roll into a log and chill an hour. Slice into coins and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden.

m.note: the Fratellis' hideout in the old restaurant
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with 200g crushed tomatoes mixed with garlic and oregano. Top with crumbled sausage from 3 Italian sausages, 150g sliced mushrooms and 250g mozzarella. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.

w.note: One-Eyed Willy's ship, full of gold
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 150g butter, whisk in 3 eggs and 150g sugar and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes. Cut off the top, hollow out, fill with chocolate coins, replace the lid and cover in ganache of 100g chocolate and 100ml cream.

d.note: the kids' summer on the docks
d.how: Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour a 375ml can of root beer slowly over each until it foams to the top. Serve with long spoons.
